items.headline: Ukrainian President Warns Proposed U.S. European Security Plan Could Benefit Russia
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that a broad European security framework floated by U.S. envoys could play into Moscow's interests by weakening NATO. He urged international negotiators to focus specifically on ending the war in Ukraine rather than reopening continental security agreements.

items.headline: Microsoft Restores Global Services After Massive Hourslong Outage
items.summary: Microsoft confirmed on Saturday that it has fully restored its global online services following a major, hourslong outage that disrupted communication tools and business operations worldwide. The company stated that the widespread disruption stemmed from a technical issue during a network capacity upgrade rather than a cyberattack.

items.headline: German Skier Emma Aicher Wins First Career World Cup Slalom Victory
items.summary: On November 14, 2026, German skier Emma Aicher achieved her first FIS Alpine Ski World Cup slalom victory in Levi, Finland, just one day after turning 23 years old. She posted a combined time of 1 minute 52.62 seconds across two runs to defeat Albania's Lara Colturi by 0.43 seconds.

items.headline: Filipino Singer Carmelle Wins Inaugural Eurovision Asia Song Contest in Bangkok
items.summary: Vocalist Carmelle from the Philippines won the first-ever Eurovision Asia Song Contest in Bangkok with her performance of "Sobra-Sobra". This historic victory marks a major milestone as the iconic song competition successfully launched its first official Asian edition.
